_doc: flow_run v2 operator script for window S1: the reference operator's actions (EventLogTxt_20251211.csv of
D:\HT9045\Staterecord\2025-12-11 17_47_57) replayed in order. Run through flow_swap.py (reference config, real paths):
FLOW_SCRIPT=<this file> FLOW_PREP_INITIALSTART=1 python flow_swap.py <tag> 900 120,300,600 T6SCB857.1 255978
Every cmd is a wb_serve WS command: main.runStartMode (tools/wb_serve.cpp:4841), main.home (:5713, 816ce9b2),
lot.start (:5757), start.run (:5669); flow_run also sends control.acquire (WebBridge/WebBridgeServer.cpp:1388) and
act.main.stateRecord (JsonBridge/ChanAction.cpp:350).
main.home = golden TfMain::BtnHomeClick (main.cpp:7120-7144): SIM build acks ok with outcome homeArmed; a ship build acks
ok=false with outcome noop (golden does nothing there), the wait is skipped and START homes by itself ('Home by Start').
HOME finished = HomeStep reaches 1600 (golden uhome.cpp:4136-4139: case 1550 closes fHome and sets 1600; case 1600 then sets
1 at :4151). The port does NOT stream fHome->iHomeStep as a tag (WebBridgeTags.cpp publishes only pump.task.load/inArm/
outArm/sht1/sht2/testHead/catchTray, :1339-1345), so the wait polls the task ring alias HomeStep (port cStateRecord.cpp:1981,
golden main.cpp:10012) through act.main.stateRecord {taskListOnly:true}; any 1600 recorded after main.home was sent counts.
InitialStart / InitialICCheck / AutoClean / production start are NOT operator actions: START in Initial Start mode runs
them (EventLog 3190-3218). They are anchor snapshots below, one Task_ListWithTime copy each the first time the task reaches
the value the reference S1 window ends with (ref_windows.json S1: InitialStartTask ..200, InitialICCheckTask ..10000,10100,
AutoCleanTask ..2000, TestHeadMotorTask 12100 = windows.json prod_anchor).
Not replayed: 17:34:18-34 the operator opened the Auto Clean form, saved 'In Arm to Shuttle2 X Offset 0.00mm ==> 0.30mm'
(EventLog 3210-3215) and pressed START again (3216) -- the resume after the Manual T.Start pause of AutoCleanPlaceToShuttle
2100->2150 (golden AutoClean/AutoClean.cpp:3619-3626, AL-7); SIM never takes that pause, and the offset is a position.
answers: the boot prompt 'Need Load last machine record?' is inert today -- the port still has it under GATE n2-18
(port cinitial.cpp:9881) and FLOW_PREP_INITIALSTART=1 makes LoadMachineRecord return before it (golden cinitial.cpp:8059-8064).
The two rules are what the reference operator answered (EventLog 3093), kept for when the gate is lifted (report B1 option A).
